origin.lens: author code on the certifier's threads: a mutated literal makes the recursion infinite

description: The skeptic's sharpening of recur-brick: the recursion step goes through Dec(x) => x - 1, so mutate-int-literal alone (no operator swap) makes it infinite. Same stack overflow, same dead certifier. Must reach a signed verdict with the overflowing mutants filed under crashedMutants.
knownIssue: Equivalent-mutant false rejection: (n <= 1) -> (n < 1) computes the same factorial for every input, so the gate rejects an honest brick on a mutant no witness can kill. Pins verdict-without-crash only; change expect to ADMIT when the catalog recognises the equivalence.
